mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting aerobic ATP renewal to the pump was most worthwhile: the resulting comparison shows how powered transport maintains gradients that passive flow would reduce.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing the pump was predictable preparation, though the passive-channel inset gave it useful context.

surprise.text: The aerobic picture distinguished fuel oxidation from oxygen's role and showed a hydrogen-ion reservoir driving ATP synthase; it did not explain how electron transfer builds that reservoir.

arbitrary.text: Nothing I chose felt purposeless, although using the cell-interior hotspot for glucose was a procedural placement whose precise outcome was uncertain.

continue.text: I would continue: the linked transport and energy constructions were useful, and I would be curious to see how later chapters connect cell processes to larger structures.
